canonicalSource.sentence: Four. Only then, act — and start with the lightest thing that works. Physical removal, barriers or changes in crop care may help. Check that the action suits the problem and monitor the result.
canonicalSource.meaningConstraint: Choose the least intensive intervention that is effective. It is not an instruction to choose the easiest action regardless of impact or effectiveness.

candidate.recommendedSesotho: ketso e bobebe ka ho fetisisa e sebetsang.
candidate.whyThisResolvesTheConflict: bobebe is the lexical choice supported for light in the sense ‘not heavy’; bonolo is glossed as easy/soft and can shift the instruction toward ease. The phrase explicitly retains effectiveness through e sebetsang. In this pest-management sequence, bobebe is the more defensible source-bound ordinary wording for least intensive while preserving ‘works’.
candidate.scope: Replace only the English predicate following the existing ‘Only then, act — and start with’ prefix. Do not translate the following methods list as part of this replacement and do not alter the safety cautions.

priorDecisionReconciliation.resolution: Keep the semantic ACCEPT and reconcile its internal wording inconsistency in favor of bobebe. The cited glossary evidence distinguishes bobebe as light (not heavy) and bonolo as easy/soft, aligning bobebe more closely with the source contrast. This chooses the source-bound text string; it does not certify local idiom or fluency.

lexicalEvidence.source: A Beginner's Tutorial in Sesotho for Peace Corps Volunteers, SESOTHO–ENGLISH glossary.
lexicalEvidence.glossaryEntries: Glossary entries distinguish bobebe as ‘light (i.e. not heavy)’/‘lightness’ from bonolo as ‘easy’/‘soft’/‘smart’ (PDF text lines 3905–3932; printed glossary pages 129–130).
lexicalEvidence.limit: This lexical evidence supports choosing bobebe over bonolo for the source contrast but does not prove the whole phrase is idiomatic to Sesotho-speaking farmers. A fluent/local review remains necessary before any approval.

rootLexicalReview.decision: Internal transcription conflict resolved in favor of the prior semantically accepted bobebe candidate. Source-bound metaphor remains visibly unreviewed; no fluent or farming approval. Not applied to learner or rendered deck.
